items.sentence: Today, low tide can expose colorful starfish on the rocks.
Today, the birds found shelter beneath the wide green leaves.
Dry soil will absorb the warm rain very rapidly.
Today, an incredible double rainbow appeared above the wet valley.
Today, healthy meals consist of fruits, grains, and fresh vegetables.
Today, snow covered the sharp peak of the tall mountain.
Today, one tall weed grew between the neat carrot rows.
One paper owl can scare birds from the field.
Today, the puddles diminish as the warm sun rises higher.
Today, these apple trees yield sweet fruit every single autumn.
